bio: John Marriott (1780–1825) was an English poet and clergyman. Marriott was born at Cotesbach in 1780, and educated at Rugby School and Christ Church, Oxford. He graduated in 1802 with a first-class degree in Classics. Between 1804 and 1808 he worked as a private tutor in the family of the Duke of Buccleuch at Dalkeith.
